ways.label: Clements Mill Road to Oamaru Hut via Te Iringa

start.name: car park 5 km along Clements Mill Road
start.quote: the car park 5 km along Clements Mill Road

via.name: clearing where the Te Iringa Hut used to be
via.quote: a clearing where the Te Iringa Hut used to be

evidence: This track leaves from the car park 5 km along Clements Mill Road.
Take the main track straight ahead and follow the true right of the Kaipo River down to Oamaru Hut, situated near the confluence of the Kaipo and Oamaru rivers.

ways.label: Taharua Road to Oamaru Hut

start.name: Taharua roadend car park
start.quote: Park in the car park beside the helicopter hanger at the Taharua roadend.

via.name: poled route through Poronui Station
via.quote: Follow the poled route through Poronui Station.

via.name: Kaipō River
via.quote: a crossing of the Kaipō River

evidence: Park in the car park beside the helicopter hanger at the Taharua roadend. Follow the poled route through Poronui Station.
From near the Mohaka River a new track links from the end of the poled route to Oamaru Hut via a crossing of the Kaipō River.

ways.label: Oamaru Hut to Boyd Hut
evidence: From Oamaru Hut the track follows the true left bank of the Oamaru River before crossing the headwaters and following the Waitawhero Stream up to a saddle.
Boyd Hut is obscured by beech forest behind the airstrip.

ways.label: Boyd Hut to Cascade Hut via Maungaorangi

via.name: confluence of the Waitawhero and Oamaru streams
via.quote: the confluence of the Waitawhero and Oamaru streams

evidence: This strenuous track from Boyd Hut follows the track over Waitawhero Saddle towards Oamaru Hut.
It then descends to Te Waiotupuritia Saddle and on down to Cascade Hut.

ways.label: Te Iringa / Oamaru Hut Track to Cascade Hut (Upper Kaipo Valley Route / Kaipo Track)

start.name: swingbridge on the Te Iringa/Oamaru Track
start.quote: the swingbridge on the Te Iringa/Oamaru Track

via.name: upper Kaipo River
via.quote: the upper reaches of the Kaipo River

via.name: ridge just south of Kaipo Saddle
via.quote: a ridge just south of Kaipo Saddle

evidence: A marked route runs from the swingbridge on the Te Iringa/Oamaru Track to Cascade Hut.
The right-hand track heads downstream for another 30 minutes to Cascade Hut.

ways.label: Cascade Hut to Clements Mill Road (Hinemaiaia Track)
evidence: The track follows the open river flats of the Tauranga-Taupo River downstream before climbing away from the river up a prominent beech-covered ridge.
The track drops down to the Clements Mill roadend following the Hinemaiaia Stream and its tributaries.

doubts: Page covers several hut tracks of a network; each described track is a way, W1 first as main only by order. Shapes recorded one_way as sections are A to B; page does not say walkers return. F1 is the only road end on Taharua Road and was taken as the Taharua roadend car park (text gives no further detail). No feature for Clements Mill Road car park/roadend. W3 saddle is probably Waitawhero Saddle (W4 mentions it on the Boyd Hut to Oamaru Hut track) but the W3 text just says 'a saddle', so no ref. The headwaters crossing in W3 and the upper Kaipo River crossings in W5 are fords (no bridge mentioned). Te Iringa Hut has burnt down and is not a hut. Boyd Airstrip access point is for aircraft; page does not say it joins Boyd Hut directly, though the airstrip lies near it. The page does not link Boyd Airstrip to a track, so 'onto' is a loose inference.
